decisive_items: carotid MRA showed carotid arteriosclerosis with limited stenosis of the intracranial left vertebral artery;
The initial diagnosis was transient ischemic attack of the vertebrobasilar system.
response.rationale: Vertebrobasilar insufficiency is more likely due to the patient's symptoms and MRA results showing limited stenosis of the intracranial left vertebral artery, whereas TIA is less likely due to the lack of improvement with rest and negative test results

rejected.why: Normal brain MRI and MRA results do not strongly support cerebral vasculitis
